title: KEAM 2025 Online Registration & Verification Window Announced
summary: CEE Kerala has announced the registration schedule for KEAM Engineering & Pharmacy courses. Candidates must keep their Class 10 & 12 details and Nativity certificates ready.
parent_tip: Check income and community certificates early. EWS and SEBC candidates receive significant tuition fee concessions in government engineering colleges.

title: JEE Main Session 1 Application Form & Information Bulletin Released
summary: National Testing Agency (NTA) has opened the portal for JEE Main Session 1. The exam will be conducted in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode across 300+ cities.
parent_tip: Ensure the student's name on Aadhaar matches their Class 10 certificate exactly to avoid biometric authentication issues on exam day.

title: NEET-UG 2025 Official Syllabus & Eligibility Criteria Confirmed by NMC
summary: NMC confirms NEET-UG will be held on the first Sunday of May. Minimum 50% aggregate in Class 12 Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (40% for SC/ST/OBC) is required.
parent_tip: NEET is a pen-and-paper OMR exam with negative marking (-1 mark). Support your child's revision without undue pressure.

title: CUET-UG 2025 Subject Mapping & Domain Test Guidelines
summary: NTA announces that students can choose up to 6 domain subjects based on Class 12 syllabus for admission into 45+ Central Universities including DU, BHU, and JNU.
parent_tip: Central Universities have very affordable fees (under ₹15,000/year for many courses) with excellent placement track records.

title: KEAM 50:50 Rank Formula Normalization Guidelines Published
summary: Government of Kerala confirms equal 50:50 weightage for KEAM Entrance score and Class 12th Board marks (PCM) with statistical normalization across CBSE, ICSE, and State boards.
parent_tip: Board marks matter just as much as entrance marks. Encourage your child to score high in Plus Two Board practicals and theory.
